theme: AF-3 bare variant in a pattern is E0409
text: CHECKER (all engines): a bare name in a pattern that equals a variant of the subject's own enum (`match c { Red => .. }` where `c: Color`), in any arm position including the last, in a `while let` or an `if let` pattern, and nested inside `Some(..)` or tuples, is now refused with E0409 naming the qualified form `Color::Red`. Before, the name bound a catch-all and the arm took every value, a silent wrong answer (W0004 at most). Shorthand struct fields and parser-made `__` names are skipped, and a name that is a variant of a different enum, or any name on a non-enum subject, still binds. The 700 tracked .ax files check identically before and after (0 hits).
